# Otto Notes

> Otto Notes is a bilingual Traditional Chinese and English website about living, working, studying, and immigrating to Canada. Its tools section is designed for free automotive, finance, and math calculators.

Primary language: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant-HK)
Secondary language: English (en-US)

## Main sections

- Blog: https://otto-notes.com/
- English blog: https://otto-notes.com/en
- Tools: https://otto-notes.com/tools
- English tools: https://otto-notes.com/en/tools
- About: https://otto-notes.com/about

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://otto-notes.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://otto-notes.com/robots.txt

Article pages contain publication dates, summaries, source content, and structured FAQ data when available. Calculator pages are designed to use a dedicated URL, a plain-language explanation, and WebApplication structured data.
